turns.question: How many customers placed more than three orders between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for customers who placed more than three orders, so I can't give that figure for 17 August to 2 October 2026; the closest metrics are Repeat customers (repeat_customers: distinct customers with a non-cancelled order in the period who have placed two or more orders in all), Active customers (customers_distinct) and Orders (orders_total).
